INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY: Review your plan after we have 30 days of history and income on at least three dates.
PLAN_REQUIRED: Confirm your essential expenses before reviewing a savings suggestion.
ESSENTIALS_UNKNOWN: Add your essential expenses first; missing expenses do not mean spare money.
INCOME_DATE_PASSED: Your expected payment date has passed. Review when you expect income next.
OVERDUE_BILL_REVIEW: Review the overdue bill before setting more money aside.
TRANSFER_RECOMMENDED: Consider setting aside {amount}, leaving an estimated {reserve} for planned essentials through {date}.
TARGET_REACHED: You have reached the current final buffer target. You can still access your savings.
EVENT_CAP_REACHED: You have used this income event's savings limit. Review again after another payment.
NOT_ENOUGH_SAFE_SURPLUS: Keep this income available for essentials. Review the plan after your next payment.
HIGH_VOLATILITY_SMALLER_STEPS: Your recent income amounts vary, so the suggestion uses smaller steps.
GUARDRAIL_FAILED: The suggestion needs review. No transfer is recommended.
